svg.title: Health, maintenance and WAF decisions at an edge
svg.desc: Protected monitoring endpoints are handled separately. Enabled maintenance ends with a 503 before the WAF. Application requests select a healthy local or peer path, then cross the selected edge WAF, Anubis and application authentication. WAF denials do not cause a failover retry.
